title: Aakhri Bar Kaleje se Laga Lo Baba
body:
Tamheed
Le Li Zainab Se Jo Shabbir Ne Maqtal Ki Raza,
Ho Ke Rukhsat Chale Khaime Se Shah-e-Karb-o-Bala.
Pehle To Thaam Liya Baap Ka Daman Aur Phir,
Jod Kar Haathon Ko Masoom Sakina Ne Kaha,
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye Baba Mere Baba, Haaye Baba Mere Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aakhiri Baar Kaleje Se Laga Lo Baba,
God Mein Apni Sakina Ko Utha Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap Ke Saath Meri Neend Chali Jaayegi,
Phir Kabhi Laut Ke Aankhon Mein Nahin Aayegi.
Apne Seene Pe Phir Ek Baar Sula Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kitne Din Beet Gaye Chhode Hue Apna Watan,
Dil Tadapta Hai Mera Yaad Jo Aati Hai Behan.
Ab To Sughra Ko Madine Se Bula Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ja Rahe Ho To Mujhe Itna Batate Jana,
Neend Aayegi Sakina Ko Kahan Par Tanha.
Jaate Jaate Mujhe Seene Pe Sula Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maine Akbar Ke Kaleje Ko Nikalte Dekha,
Khoon-e-Besheer Ko Bhi Maine Ubalte Dekha.
Dam Nikal Jaayega Mera, Mujhe Sambhalo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Judai Ka Ye Sadma Na Utha Paungi,
Yaad Mein Aap Ki Ghut Ghut Ke Main Mar Jaungi.
Aur Kuch Der Mere Naaz Utha Lo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Baap Se Ro Ke Sharafat Ye Sakina Ne Kaha,
Chhod Kar Mujhko Yahan Ran Ko Na Jao Tanha.
Laaj Rakh Lijiye, Meri Baat Na Taalo Baba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aakhiri Baar Kaleje Se Laga Lo Baba.
author: Sharafat Jansathi
